Stock market news | Nvidia surges 31% as Jensen Huang returns as CEO

Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO following an announcement on X. US President Donald Trump had urged the board on Truth Social to rehire him, saying his return would be beneficial for both the company and the United States.
